fingerspelling.model: fingerspell.npz (3 averaged NumPy MLPs) + letters_bank.npz (encoder embeddings)
fingerspelling.data: agent_data/en_alpha (30 lessons, 26 channels, eye-checked seeds) + TSL-ONE-S (25 signers)

personal_sign_memory: client-side; one averaged prototype per word / letter per user (models are never changed)

bank_cleaning.rule: auto-aligned sentence word whose embedding matches another word better by > 0.15 (data_prep/qc/conversation_label_audit.csv)

decision_v8.what: split-sign merge model + calibrated P(correct) (temperature, 13 features) + Accept / Uncertain / Reject
decision_v8.tuned: python main.py decision tune (tune sets only)

decision_v81.what: hand-shape cue fused with the encoder's reading of each segment (models/hand_bank.npz, modules/handshape.py) · v8 top-5 re-ranker (now passes its tune bar) · split test for fluent signing (≥ 2-sign utterances) · guarded grammar re-rank · repeat guard keeps P ≥ 0.8 · English fingerspelling always on (spotting.json alphabet) · จีน / ประเทศ + 61 sign variants in the vocabulary
decision_v81.tuned: python main.py decision hands → decision tune --write (tune sets only)

v9.base: v8.1 (models/Jack-model) — encoder / tagger / span head / bank unchanged
v9.reader: span head + hand-shape cue (w 1.0) + Thai landmark encoder ensemble as second opinion (onnx/lmenc.onnx + lm_bank.npz, w 0.3)
v9.enrolled_reader: personal bank active → the v8.1 decoder + calibration (spotting.json / segment_calibration.json 'enrolled'); chosen on enrolled tune sentences
v9.grammar_rerank: off (recognition first; grammar = optional LLM layer)
v9.calibration: temperature + LR (v9 features incl. landmark-encoder agreement) + isotonic; tau_accept 0.88 / tau_reject 0.19 (accepted precision >= 0.90 on every tune set)
v9.fingerspelling: lone letter >= 0.95 (v8.1 0.98), >= 0.7 right after the name sign
v9.chosen_on: tune sets only (python main.py decision tune --start v8.1)
